name: Petal Gas Storage Extension Pipeline

values.EndLocation: near Enterprise, Clarke County (Southern Natural Gas and Destin Pipeline interconnects)

researcher_notes: Operating since July 2002 per EIA Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 246 (Petal Gas Storage Extension, Petal Gas Storage LLC, Lateral, Completed, 58.7 mi, 36 in, 680 MMcf/d, cost 94.3 million, FERC docket CP01-69). Federal Register notice of application (5 Feb 2001) describes 58.7 mi of new bidirectional 36 in pipe from the Petal storage header in Forrest County through Jones and Jasper Counties to interconnects with Southern Natural Gas and Destin Pipeline near Enterprise, Clarke County, plus a compressor station near Heidelberg and a 0.3 mi Transco connection; the notice quotes 700,000 Mcf/d and about 94.3 million dollars (EIA figure used for capacity). Match check: no Petal row and no row with Forrest/Jones/Jasper/Clarke endpoints in the 2026-10-02 snapshot; Gulf South rows P0197 (system row) and its expansion rows do not list this line, though Gulf South now owns Petal storage so the current owner and whether the line is carried inside Gulf South system row P0197 should be checked by a person; owner shown is the 2002 sponsor. Row shape: stand-alone name used because the line was a separate Petal system; if the team prefers the parent shape, PipelineName would be Gulf South Gas Pipeline. Start year 2002 not staged as StartYear1 field name unverified. Route not researched: no route staged, RouteType/RouteAccuracy left for route creation.
